integrity.statement: Analytical inverse and exact row-sign computation, supplemented by independent finite rational design tests. Priority subject to unindexed equivalent design literature.

limitations: Real equally weighted observed-cell two-way additive least-squares projection on square tables with deletion of a matching; does not cover missing-cell extrapolation, other deletion patterns, rectangular shapes, arbitrary weights or minimum over alternative projections.
title: Sharp matching-deletion stability for two-way additive least squares
